heading: Name and registration
text:
### Name and registration [LNLS.2.1]

`linear_scan` is a strategy capability of [LCAP.1]. A program has
`linear_scan: false` through its dialect or a line of its `use` block
([LDIA.2.1]), resolved per [LDIA.3.3]. Every built-in dialect but `base` has
`linear_scan: true` ([LDIA.9]).
